replace description: Whether to replace these settings from lower-priority packs, or combine them.
enable_query_cache description: Enable cache features, according to the rest of the options. Useful to disable the cache altogether.
cache_blind_queries_on_type description: Whether to cache blind queries while typing a single command
cache_informed_queries_on_type descripti: Whether to cache informed queries while typing a single command
cache_informed_queries_on_type tip: The benefit of caching informed queries is significantly lower than that of caching blind queries
cache_blind_queries description: Whether to cache blind queries across multiple commands
cache_blind_queries warning: This may cause nuisances if the commands you can execute change frequently
cache_informed_queries description: Whether to cache informed queries across multiple commands
cache_informed_queries warning: This may cause nuisances if the commands you can execute change frequently
cache_informed_queries tip: The benefit of caching informed queries is significantly lower than that of caching blind queries
query_cache_max_entries description: Maximum number of entries to store in the cache. Separate for each query type.
query_cache_max_entries warning: Each entry can contain an arbitrary number of suggestions, so the memory usage can be high
query_cache_expiration_seconds descripti: Number of seconds after which a cache entry will expire
query_cache_expiration_seconds warning: Setting this too high will aggravate the nuisances caused by changing commands
enable_split_cache description: Enable caching of splits of flatcase commands
split_cache_max_entries description: Maximum number of split commands to keep in the split cache
